known_events.E4-final-day: Last day: only fraud transactions, mostly to receivers with no recent activity.
known_events.E1-volume-lull: Legitimate volume drops to 1-28k a day on Jan 3-5 (from ~450k) and recovers on Jan 6; the recovery stands out against a baseline that includes the lull.
known_events.E2-dispute-ramp: Disputes are filed 1 hour to 14 days after their transaction and nothing exists before Jan 1, so daily disputes ramp up (20 to 338 a day) over the first 14 days.
known_events.E3-volume-collapse: From Jan 18 legitimate volume falls ~20x (to 10-55k a day) while fraud stays near-constant (~262 a day), so volumes, mix and fraud share all shift; the 7-day baseline needs until Jan 25 to adjust.
